sources.title: RESOLVE Ecoregions and Biomes
sources.license: CC BY 4.0, as declared both in ArcGIS item licenseInfo and the feature-level LICENSE field
sources.feature_set: Seven named Bolivian-intersecting ecoregions selected by ECO_ID values in the current feature source mapping. REST query returns original full global ecoregion polygons, not clipped province shapes.
sources.query: FeatureServer/0/query; exact where ECO_NAME IN (...) list and outFields FID,ECO_NAME,BIOME_NAME,REALM,ECO_BIOME_,NNH,ECO_ID,LICENSE; returnGeometry=true,outSR=4326,f=geojson. Exact URL in query receipt.
sources.source_suitability: Explicitly ecological: ArcGIS item says ecoregions use natural rather than political boundaries. Suitable to identify physical ecoregions, not administrative provinces or sovereign ownership.
sources.restoration: Run the retained REST query or export from the pinned layer; retain original query response and check CC BY attribution.
